title: Email/copy: keywords deserialized as Vec<Keyword> instead of HashMap<Keyword,bool>
description: email.rs:1140 deserializes copy keywords as Vec<Keyword>, identical to the Email/import bug fixed in pass 9. RFC 8621 §6.1 keywords wire format is String[Boolean] (a JSON object); a valid client payload {'$seen': true} fails serde deserialization as Vec and produces a spurious invalidProperties error.
